---
name: design-docs
description: 'Keep design documentation consistent and approval-gated when editing ClipYantra design files.'
applyTo: 'docs/design/**/*.md'
---

- Label proposals, approved decisions and implemented states distinctly.
- Never convert a proposal to approved without an explicit human approval record.
- Use consistent component/object terminology across screen specs and architecture docs.
- Document alternatives, assumptions, risks and rationale.
- Include accessibility, responsive and all-state behavior in every screen/component spec.
- Link to existing source-of-truth documents instead of duplicating them.
